semiconductor_relevance: Low — Fluence Technology focuses on photonics and ultrafast technology rather than semiconductor manufacturing or materials.
summary: Fluence Technology is a Poland-based company specializing in all-fiber ultrashort pulse technology, primarily aimed at applications in photonics. Their robust designs are engineered for reliability and minimal maintenance, making them suitable for various industrial applications, although not specifically within the semiconductor sector.

regional_presence.Poland: Fluence Technology is headquartered in Poland, focusing on commercializing technology developed in local academic institutions.
